extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap. Checked trial registration (NCT 05629832, registered 2022-11-14, Beijing Chao-Yang Hospital, China) against registrations in COHORTS.md clusters: EPVent-1 (NCT00127491), EPVent-2 (beitler_2019), mannheim_boesing (DRKS00017449, DRKS00013967), mgh_lung_rescue (NCT02503241/NCT02105220). Enrolment January 2023 to December 2024 postdates all published reports of those cohorts. Single centre in Beijing, China; no shared authors with any cluster. Unique cohort.
unclear_items: design.enrolment_start/enrolment_end: text states 'From January 1, 2023, to December 31, 2024, a total of 195 patients... were admitted' but Figure 1 flowchart states 'From January 1st, 2023, to April 30th, 2023, totally 151 patients pneumonia induced ARDS admission to RICU' and 77 exclusions — the screening window and screening totals conflict between text and flowchart; enrolment end recorded as 2024-12 from the text.
population.n_vasopressors: text says 'Twenty patients received a norepinephrine infusion' but Table 1 rows sum to 9 + 12 = 21; the Table 1 sum was recorded as derived and the discrepancy flagged.

intervention.balloon_calibration.method: paper says only 'occlusion technique was used to confirm the appropriate balloon location' without naming the test or stating how filling volume was chosen; coded 'other' rather than dynamic_occlusion_test because the manoeuvre details are absent.
intervention.ptp_computation.method: coded absolute_pes_subtraction (Talmor-style expiratory Ptp target) but the paper never explicitly states the Ptp formula; inference from the Ptp-guided protocol.
population.n_ecmo: ECMO is never mentioned; left null rather than recording 0.
feasibility.n_placement_attempted: inferred as the 20 Ptp-group patients in whom Pes measurement was used; the paper does not state placement attempts or success counts.
eligible_design: pilot pathophysiological RCT; accepted as an RCT design though its outcomes are largely pathophysiological.
outcomes Cpa/RVEF/Do2I/Vo2I dynamic trajectories: numeric values over time appear only in Figures 2 and 3 and would require digitisation.
adults_18_plus criterion: explicit 18-year age criterion is stated, so no inference was needed.
data_only_in_figure: LV ejection fraction dynamic trajectories over 5 days (Figure 3C)
extraction_flags.general_notes: Figure 1 flowchart conflicts with the text on screening dates (Jan–Apr 2023, 151 patients) and screening total (195 patients Jan 2023–Dec 2024); the flowchart's exclusion list (77 items including 'Dropout (n=34)') does not sum to 151−40, suggesting an internal inconsistency. TTE-based outcomes (RVED/LVED, TAPSE, EF) had significant intergroup differences (p = 0.044, 0.047, 0.048) but no dedicated schema domain beyond hemodynamics; recorded in data_only_in_figure and general_notes. Pulmonary vascular resistance index and right ventricular stroke work index were reported lower in the Ptp group over 72 hours but p-values for these contrasts appear only in prose ('no significant difference in the PVRI'). Hospital length of stay was listed as a secondary endpoint but never reported.
